The “father of the father” of George Washington is his paternal grandfather, **Lawrence Washington** (1659 – 1698).  

- George Washington’s father was Augustine Washington (1694 – 1743).  
- Augustine Washington was the son of Lawrence Washington, who served as a militia captain and a member of the Virginia House of Burgesses.  

Thus, Lawrence Washington is the father of George Washington’s father.
